evidence.title: TSMC fab equipment demand nearly doubles in six months - AI surge pushes 2026 CapEx toward $64B amid tool shortages
evidence.summary: SEMICON Taiwan reporting says TSMC equipment demand rose to about 1.9 times the end-2025 estimate within six months; 2026 capex expectations moved toward US$60-64B while tool shortages remain a constraint.

evidence.title: 辛耘8月營收寫新高/月增1成；自製設備動能靚
evidence.summary: 辛耘8月營收10.68億元、年增18.06%並創單月新高；公司表示自製設備至年底滿載、2026出貨量估增50%，2027依客戶預估仍滿載，部分客戶已預訂2028產能。

evidence.title: 公告：志聖 2026年8月合併營收8.66億元 年增60.73%
